name: Door
description: A door that opens for the player inside a level (the level change is an exit behind it). Applies to every behaviour-7 type: set "schema": "door" on the object. Lock bits other than the squadron lock are not decoded yet.

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: squadrons with this door id lock it (0 = none); only the first door with an id gets locked, so give each locked door its own id
